input: Country: Belgium. Purchaser Name: CITY OF TUBIZE. Summary: Service Concession for Parking Management in Tubize. Description: The purpose of this contract is to implement an optimal parking management policy, that is to say one that is efficient, effective and effective, by prioritizing the following four objectives: - Streamline circulation by improving rotation parking in the city center of Tubize; - Encourage multimodality (i.e. promote other types of transport in terms of alternative solutions for the benefit of citizens according to their budget or their ideological values) and with a view to to increase the quality of life in the city center; - Support commercial attractiveness through the short-term parking policy near businesses. This will improve attendance at businesses located in the hypermarket. downtown; - Free up spaces in public space for other developments. The Contracting Authority expects the Concessionaire to manage parking using a participatory and progressive approach. By participatory management, This means taking into account the interests of the City, its residents and traders in order to participate in the achievement of the sustainable development objectives of the city as set by municipal authorities. By evolutionary management we mean a adaptation of parking management to technological, social and environmental developments. input: Country: Belgium. Purchaser Name: SOLVED. Summary: Framework Agreement for Bicycle Leasing for Employees of Solva, its Partners and their Mutual Constituent Entities.. Description: This assignment aims to conclude a framework agreement for the supply of lease bicycles and associated services. Description: The assignment includes the purchase of trucks with a diesel drive for regional and urban use. The trucks are divided into three plots in function of their maximum permitted mass (MTM) (16 tons, 19 tons and 26 tons). A basic configuration is for each of these plots (Chassis-Cabin), called the model offered, as well as described various conversion options. If an offered model can also be configured in a higher or lower MTM, a different AS configuration or a version for off-road use, this can also be ordered.
